title: Judge upholds Plymouth agreement with Native American group but says town doesn’t have to provide stage
author: Samantha Genzer
bullets: Local News The United American Indians of New England argues a stage is essential to its National Day of Mourning demonstration, which it says draws more than a thousand people.
People march during the National Day of Morning protest on Thanksgiving Day, in Plymouth on November 28, 2024.

Joseph Prezioso/AFP A Superior Court judge ruled Tuesday that Plymouth must continue honoring its decades-old agreement with a Native American-led advocacy group, but does not have to provide a stage for the group’s annual demonstration on Thanksgiving, court documents show.
